mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails if the await_verdict.go file key or the awaitVerdictWithOptions or handleVerdictResult key is still in area_a5_test.go's ratchet while the code is over the limit, and fails if any remaining key grows. All three keys are removed. awaitVerdictWithOptions is an orchestrator over enterAwaitVerdict (option, agent and status preconditions), acquireAwaitOwnership, awaitBudgetExhausted and awaitVerdictRun.wait (watcher loop, with observe shared by the abort check, the watcher and the polling fallback); handleVerdictResult is a three-way classification over approvedAwaitResult, reclaimRejected (with reclaimFailureResult) and finishNonAwaitable. await_verdict.go keeps entry, preconditions, ownership and the waiting loops, await_verdict_outcome.go the typed outcomes and the recovered-verdict classification, await_verdict_finish.go the finish, release and budget reporting, each file under the limit.

TestOracleA5Supplement compares the json, human and state captures of AW1-AW11 (TERMINAL for a decided task with no verdict and for a last-attempt rejection with nothing recoverable; ALREADY_TRANSITIONED for a merged approved task, a blocked or re-claimed rejected task with revise, a task taken by another doer and a recovered verdict after a blocked reclaim; PAUSED; NEW_ATTEMPT; the budget gate; the non-awaitable refusal) against goldens committed in cdfeb0674 before any production edit, generated by regen write-new on the unchanged tree. The delivered AV1-AV3 cover REJECTED, APPROVED and the non-doer refusal; POLL, TIMEOUT and ABORTED depend on elapsed time and stay with the white-box await tests. TestSupplementGoldenCoverage pins coverage; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a5/... reproduces every golden.

The await-verdict white-box tests (await_verdict_test.go, await_pause_test.go, await_policy_test.go, generation_fence_lifecycle_test.go, work_admission_test.go) keep every assertion, changed only by string(...) conversions of the typed constants, and run under the race detector against the split awaitVerdictWithOptions and handleVerdictResult; they pin the watcher and polling fallback, abort and pause handling, budget remainder, recovered verdicts, the reclaim results and ownership release.

TestAwaitVerdictVocabularyKeepsItsValues compares each AwaitVerdictOutcome and AwaitSafeAction constant with the literal it replaced, and TestAwaitVerdictResultKeepsStringFields pins that AwaitVerdictResult.Verdict and SafeAction stay JSON strings reached by conversion. Safe actions and effects of the lifecycle error use the delivered LifecycleSafeActionStop and LifecycleEffectsNone, the released-claim event models.TaskEventDoerClaimReleased, the recovered verdict event models.TaskEventName; the budget reason and the unfenced submission index are named constants with unchanged values, and the test-replaceable awaitVerdictNow, newAwaitVerdictWatcher and runAwaitVerdictPolling stay variables.
TestOracleA5 compares the delivered A5 goldens live; none changes (git diff of internal/oracle/a5/testdata/golden against the starting commit is empty), and no older supplement golden changes.
TestS1SizeGuard enforces that area_a5_test.go ratchet keys only shrink: the three K-AWT await-verdict keys are gone and no key was added or raised.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and A5 oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e and the race run are mandatory with it.
